open_items: Default --boot-size 100 is too small for ubuntu:24.04 on linux/riscv64 (disclosed in the PR Notes; owner decision carried from r13).
The debian:11 removal is an isolated tests: commit; upstream may prefer it dropped or handled separately.
Upstream (or a later linka-cloud submission) may ask for riscv64 e2e coverage that the owner declined.
Round 3 P2 note deferred: the Notes sentence on the boot size does not explain that the rest of /boot plus FAT overhead push the 98 MB kernel+initrd over 100 MB.
